rewrites.//: The two addresses people are actually given. /login is the one entry point: it signs the caller in and forwards them to whichever of the three dashboards is theirs. Rewrites rather than redirects so the pretty URL stays in the address bar; that is also why the console CSP below has to name them, since a header matches the request path and knows nothing about the rewrite.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

headers.//: The consoles are the only pages that talk to anything but this origin: Firebase Auth to sign in, and the Semper API to read and change seats. connect-src is widened for them ALONE — every other page, including the legal pages and the auth continue-URLs, keeps the default-src 'self' policy above. script-src is deliberately NOT relaxed: the Firebase SDK is served from Hosting's own /__/firebase/ namespace, which is same-origin, so no CDN exception is needed. __API_ORIGIN__ is substituted at deploy time alongside __CLOUD_RUN_URL__ in gateway/openapi.yaml — see public/console/README.md.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' __API_ORIGIN__ https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com https://securetoken.googleapis.com; frame-src https://__AUTH_DOMAIN__; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

headers.//: /login and /account rewrite into /console/, but a Hosting header is matched against the REQUEST path, so without this they would be served the strict global policy above and could reach neither Firebase Auth nor the API. The value must stay character-for-character identical to the /console/** policy; the deploy-time substitution of __API_ORIGIN__ and __AUTH_DOMAIN__ rewrites both together.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' __API_ORIGIN__ https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com https://securetoken.googleapis.com; frame-src https://__AUTH_DOMAIN__; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
